method: Merged the three independent full-question semantic reviews into a normalized preparation taxonomy. Topics are ranked study units, while broad domains are navigation only. Duplicate and near-duplicate proposals were reconciled by tested knowledge rather than wording or keywords; examples are limited to row indices explicitly cited in the reports.

topics.description_sl: Prepoznavanje filmov po dogodkih, prizoriščih, protagonistih, bitjih ali rekvizitih.
topics.description_en: Recognition of films from events, settings, protagonists, creatures or props.
topics.inclusion: Knowledge internal to a particular non-Slovenian film.
topics.exclusion: Actor identification, director attribution and recurring franchise lore.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se filmov po glavnih likih, prizoriščih, preobratih in rekvizitih.
topics.study_focus_en: Study films by main characters, settings, turning points and props.

topics.description_sl: Povezave med mednarodnimi igralci, filmskimi naslovi in njihovimi najbolj znanimi vlogami.
topics.description_en: Associations among international actors, film titles and their best-known roles.
topics.inclusion: The actor-role or actor-film mapping is the tested knowledge.
topics.exclusion: Plot facts, director-film attribution and ensemble connections across several actors.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži igralce z značilnimi vlogami, liki in ključnimi filmi.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect actors with signature roles, characters and key films.

topics.description_sl: Avtorstvo režije, prepoznavne filmografije ter tehnični in zgodovinski mejniki svetovnega filma.
topics.description_en: Directorial authorship, recognisable filmographies and technical or historical cinema milestones.
topics.inclusion: Director-film mapping or a landmark in cinema history is central.
topics.exclusion: Slovenian cinema history, acting roles and plot-only questions.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži režiserje s ključnimi filmi, obdobji in filmskimi inovacijami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect directors with key films, periods and cinematic innovations.

topics.label_sl: Filmske zasedbe in povezave med igralci
topics.label_en: Film casts and connections among actors
topics.description_sl: Skupni filmi, soigralci, osebne povezave in drugi odnosi znotraj filmskih zasedb.
topics.description_en: Shared films, co-stars, personal connections and other relationships within film casts.
topics.inclusion: The question compares or connects multiple screen performers.
topics.exclusion: A single signature role or a film's internal plot.
topics.study_focus_sl: Vadi povezovanje soigralcev, skupnih filmov in pomembnih osebnih povezav.
topics.study_focus_en: Practise linking co-stars, shared films and notable personal connections.

topics.description_sl: Razmerja med knjigo, dramo, radijsko igro, muzikalom, scenarijem in filmsko različico.
topics.description_en: Relationships among books, plays, radio works, musicals, screenplays and film versions.
topics.inclusion: The source, adaptation pathway or screenwriter is the tested knowledge.
topics.exclusion: Book-only plot facts and ordinary film-plot recognition.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži ekranizacije z avtorji predlog, scenaristi in izvirnim medijem.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect adaptations with source authors, screenwriters and original media.

topics.description_sl: Nominacije, osvojene ali zavrnjene nagrade, kategorije, festivalske lokacije in rekordi.
topics.description_en: Nominations, won or declined prizes, categories, festival locations and records.
topics.inclusion: Formal film awards and organised film festivals.
topics.exclusion: Music festivals and general celebrity biography.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se nagrad po kategoriji, prejemniku, filmu, letu in festivalskem kraju.
topics.study_focus_en: Study awards by category, recipient, film, year and festival location.

topics.label_sl: Mednarodne televizijske serije, sitkomi in liki
topics.label_en: International television series, sitcoms and characters
topics.description_sl: Naslovi, ustvarjalci, liki, odnosi, kraji in premise mednarodnih igranih serij.
topics.description_en: Titles, creators, characters, relationships, settings and premises of international live-action series.
topics.inclusion: Scripted television series other than children's animation.
topics.exclusion: Feature films, Slovenian entertainment programmes and print-first comics.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži serije z liki, igralci, prizorišči in osnovno premiso.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect series with characters, actors, settings and core premises.

topics.description_sl: Kanali, voditelji, sezone, tekmovalci in ponavljajoči se liki slovenskih televizijskih produkcij.
topics.description_en: Channels, presenters, seasons, contestants and recurring characters in Slovenian television productions.
topics.inclusion: Knowledge tied primarily to a Slovenian television programme.
topics.exclusion: Film acting and a presenter's unrelated music career.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži oddaje s kanali, voditelji, obdobji in značilnimi rubrikami ali liki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect programmes with channels, presenters, periods and signature segments or characters.

topics.description_sl: Liki, videz, odnosi in ponavljajoča se dejanja v risankah ter otroških oddajah.
topics.description_en: Characters, appearance, relationships and recurring actions in cartoons and children's programmes.
topics.inclusion: Screen-first animation or children's television.
topics.exclusion: Traditional fairy tales, book-first children's literature and print-comic origins.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se serij po likih, njihovih odnosih, videzu in značilnih dejanjih.
topics.study_focus_en: Study series by characters, relationships, appearance and recurring actions.

topics.label_sl: Filmske franšize, superjunaki in znanstvena fantastika
topics.label_en: Screen franchises, superheroes and science fiction
topics.description_sl: Ponavljajoči se svetovi, rodovi, junaki, predmeti in kanon velikih filmskih franšiz.
topics.description_en: Recurring worlds, lineages, heroes, objects and canon of major screen franchises.
topics.inclusion: Cross-film franchise mythology, including screen superheroes and major science-fiction sagas.
topics.exclusion: Self-contained film plots and print-publication history.
topics.study_focus_sl: Nariši povezave med deli franšize, liki, rodovi, organizacijami in predmeti.
topics.study_focus_en: Map franchise instalments, characters, lineages, organisations and objects.

topics.description_sl: Avtorstvo, naslov, motiv, narodnost in lokacija znamenitih slik.
topics.description_en: Authorship, title, subject, nationality and location of canonical paintings.
topics.inclusion: A particular painting or painter is the tested object.
topics.exclusion: Sculpture, architecture and the mechanics of an art technique.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži slike z avtorji, naslovi, motivi, obdobji in zbirkami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect paintings with artists, titles, subjects, periods and collections.

topics.description_sl: Dela, biografije, sorodstva in knjižne ilustracije slovenskih likovnih ustvarjalcev.
topics.description_en: Works, biographies, family connections and book illustration by Slovenian visual artists.
topics.inclusion: The creator's Slovenian artistic identity is central.
topics.exclusion: Architecture, film production and book authorship without illustration.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži umetnike z deli, tehnikami, ilustriranimi knjigami in biografijo.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect artists with works, techniques, illustrated books and biography.

topics.description_sl: Avtorji, materiali, oblike in lokacije tridimenzionalnih, mozaičnih ter instalacijskih del.
topics.description_en: Artists, materials, forms and locations of sculpture, mosaics and installations.
topics.inclusion: A non-architectural three-dimensional or mosaic artwork is central.
topics.exclusion: Buildings, paintings and public monuments tested only by location.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži dela z avtorji, materiali, postopki in postavitvami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect works with artists, materials, methods and settings.

topics.description_sl: Slikarski materiali, orodja, prostoročno merjenje, tehnike in postopki ohranjanja umetnin.
topics.description_en: Painting materials, tools, freehand measurement, techniques and art-conservation processes.
topics.inclusion: How visual art is created, analysed or conserved.
topics.exclusion: Identification of an artist or artwork and general household tools.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi materiale, orodja, značilnosti tehnik in naloge restavratorja.
topics.study_focus_en: Review materials, tools, technique features and the conservator's role.

topics.description_sl: Avtorstvo, slog, tip, posvetitev in oblikovanje pomembnih stavb ter spomenikov.
topics.description_en: Authorship, style, type, dedication and design of major buildings and monuments.
topics.inclusion: Architectural or design knowledge beyond merely locating a site.
topics.exclusion: City-landmark location, museum collections and natural landmarks.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži stavbe z arhitekti, slogi, funkcijami, naročniki in obdobji.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect buildings with architects, styles, functions, patrons and periods.

topics.description_sl: Vrste, posvetitve, zgodovina in slog pomembnih antičnih, krščanskih ter islamskih stavb.
topics.description_en: Types, dedications, histories and styles of major ancient, Christian and Islamic buildings.
topics.inclusion: The building's sacred function, dedication or architectural identity is primary.
topics.exclusion: Religious doctrine and simple geographic location of a landmark.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se svetišč po veri, tipu, posvetitvi, slogu in zgodovini gradnje.
topics.study_focus_en: Study sacred sites by religion, type, dedication, style and building history.

topics.description_sl: Lokacije, zbirke, vodstva, bienali in vloge muzejev, galerij ter kulturnih kompleksov.
topics.description_en: Locations, collections, leadership, biennials and functions of museums, galleries and cultural complexes.
topics.inclusion: The institution, collection or cultural-venue function is tested.
topics.exclusion: An artwork considered independently and ordinary city-landmark identification.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži ustanove z mesti, zbirkami, dogodki in značilnimi nalogami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect institutions with cities, collections, events and characteristic roles.

topics.description_sl: Gledališke ustanove, baletni ustvarjalci, improvizacija, odri in organizacija uprizoritev.
topics.description_en: Theatre institutions, ballet creators, improvisation, stages and organisation of live performance.
topics.inclusion: Performance practice, venue or practitioner rather than a dramatic text.
topics.exclusion: Drama as literature, opera as music and film acting.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži ustanove, ustvarjalce, uprizoritvene pojme in značilne prostore.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect institutions, practitioners, performance concepts and typical spaces.

topics.description_sl: Modni oblikovalci, zgodovinski slogi, ikonični kosi in načrtovanje prepoznavnih izdelkov.
topics.description_en: Fashion designers, historical styles, iconic garments and design of recognisable products.
topics.inclusion: Design authorship, fashion history or the deliberate form of a product.
topics.exclusion: Everyday garment use, grooming and generic brand-logo recognition.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži oblikovalce z izdelki, obdobji, silhuetami in oblikovalskimi inovacijami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect designers with products, periods, silhouettes and design innovations.

topics.description_sl: Državni organi, veje oblasti, občine, nosilci funkcij in formalne pristojnosti.
topics.description_en: State bodies, branches of government, municipalities, officeholders and formal powers.
topics.inclusion: Current constitutional or administrative structure of independent Slovenia.
topics.exclusion: Independence history, state symbols and foreign political systems.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi organe, pristojnosti, postopke, mandate in ravni uprave.
topics.study_focus_en: Review institutions, powers, procedures, terms and administrative levels.

topics.label_sl: Slovenska državnost, simboli in nekdanji denar
topics.label_en: Slovenian statehood, symbols and former currency
topics.description_sl: Osamosvojitveni mejniki, ustavni simboli, grbi, tolarji in državne slovesnosti.
topics.description_en: Independence milestones, constitutional symbols, heraldry, tolars and state commemorations.
topics.inclusion: Slovenian sovereignty or official national and municipal symbolism.
topics.exclusion: Routine government administration and foreign flags or currencies.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se mejnikov osamosvojitve, simbolov, avtorjev grba in tolarskih motivov.
topics.study_focus_en: Study independence milestones, symbols, heraldry authorship and tolar designs.

topics.description_sl: Karantanija, ustoličevanje, knezi ter zgodnje politične in verske spremembe na slovenskem ozemlju.
topics.description_en: Carantania, enthronement, princes and early political or religious changes in Slovenian territory.
topics.inclusion: Medieval institutions and events specifically tied to Slovenian lands.
topics.exclusion: General European crusades and modern Slovenian statehood.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi Karantanijo, obrede, nosilce oblasti in zgodnje verske prehode.
topics.study_focus_en: Review Carantania, rituals, rulers and early religious transitions.

topics.description_sl: Jugoslavija, partizanstvo, protesti, industrializacija ter razvoj modernih slovenskih ustanov in infrastrukture.
topics.description_en: Yugoslavia, Partisan history, protests, industrialisation and development of modern Slovenian institutions and infrastructure.
topics.inclusion: Nineteenth- and twentieth-century processes in Slovenian history.
topics.exclusion: Current administration, medieval history and location-only heritage questions.
topics.study_focus_sl: Sestavi časovnico političnih, družbenih, industrijskih in infrastrukturnih mejnikov.
topics.study_focus_en: Build a timeline of political, social, industrial and infrastructure milestones.

topics.label_sl: Slovenske regije, kraji, občine in lokalne identitete
topics.label_en: Slovenian regions, towns, municipalities and local identities
topics.description_sl: Umestitev krajev, občin, trgov, zdravilišč in lokalnih posebnosti v slovenske pokrajine.
topics.description_en: Placement of towns, municipalities, squares, spas and local distinctions within Slovenian regions.
topics.inclusion: Local identity or administrative placement is the tested relation.
topics.exclusion: Rivers, roads, individual architectural authorship and cultural works merely made in Slovenia.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se regij, občinskih središč, lokalnih vzdevkov, pridelkov in znamenitosti.
topics.study_focus_en: Study regions, municipal centres, local nicknames, products and landmarks.

topics.description_sl: Trgi, ustanove, zgodovinski prevoz in druge notranje prostorske povezave v Ljubljani.
topics.description_en: Squares, institutions, historic transport and other internal spatial relationships in Ljubljana.
topics.inclusion: Knowledge requiring an internal map of Ljubljana.
topics.exclusion: National institutions tested by constitutional powers and architectural authorship.
topics.study_focus_sl: Preglej mestne četrti, trge, ustanove, prometne mejnike in njihove lege.
topics.study_focus_en: Review districts, squares, institutions, transport landmarks and their locations.

topics.label_sl: Slovenske reke, izviri, mokrišča in slapovi
topics.label_en: Slovenian rivers, springs, wetlands and waterfalls
topics.description_sl: Porečja, pritoki, izviri, sotočja, mokrišča, rečni otoki in slapovi Slovenije.
topics.description_en: Basins, tributaries, springs, confluences, wetlands, river islands and waterfalls of Slovenia.
topics.inclusion: Named Slovenian inland-water systems and their map relationships.
topics.exclusion: World hydrography, water chemistry and artistic depictions of rivers.
topics.study_focus_sl: Vadi zemljevid porečij, izvirov, pritokov, sotočij, mokrišč in slapov.
topics.study_focus_en: Practise a map of basins, sources, tributaries, confluences, wetlands and falls.

topics.label_sl: Slovenske gore, jame in zavarovana območja
topics.label_en: Slovenian mountains, caves and protected areas
topics.description_sl: Vrhovi, prelazi, poti, jame, naravni parki in gorske naravne znamenitosti Slovenije.
topics.description_en: Peaks, passes, trails, caves, natural parks and mountain landmarks of Slovenia.
topics.inclusion: Location or identity of a Slovenian mountain, cave or protected landscape.
topics.exclusion: Climbing achievements and generic geological formation processes.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži vrhove, gorovja, prelaze, jame in parke z njihovimi regijami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect peaks, ranges, passes, caves and parks with their regions.

topics.label_sl: Slovenske stavbe, gradovi, spomeniki in infrastruktura
topics.label_en: Slovenian buildings, castles, monuments and infrastructure
topics.description_sl: Lokacija, identiteta in zgodovina slovenskih gradov, stolpov, spomenikov, viaduktov ter javnih objektov.
topics.description_en: Location, identity and history of Slovenian castles, towers, monuments, viaducts and public structures.
topics.inclusion: A named Slovenian built site considered as local heritage.
topics.exclusion: Architectural style or authorship when that is the principal knowledge.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži objekte s kraji, namenom, obdobjem in ključnimi zgodovinskimi dogodki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect sites with places, functions, periods and key historical events.

topics.label_sl: Slovenski promet, podjetja in industrijska dediščina
topics.label_en: Slovenian transport, companies and industrial heritage
topics.description_sl: Slovenske ladje, letalska podjetja, tovarne, proizvodi in prometno-industrijski mejniki.
topics.description_en: Slovenian ships, airlines, factories, products and transport-industrial milestones.
topics.inclusion: Domestic company or industrial history is the central preparation unit.
topics.exclusion: Global vehicle brands, present-day road rules and pure route geography.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži podjetja z mesti, izdelki, prevoznimi sredstvi in zgodovinskimi mejniki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect companies with towns, products, vehicles and historical milestones.

topics.label_sl: Slovenske prireditve, festivali in spominski dnevi
topics.label_en: Slovenian events, festivals and commemorative days
topics.description_sl: Kraj, čas, program in pomen slovenskih festivalov, javnih praznikov ter tradicionalnih prireditev.
topics.description_en: Place, timing, programme and meaning of Slovenian festivals, public holidays and traditional events.
topics.inclusion: A named Slovenian event or commemoration is central.
topics.exclusion: General Christian holidays, music contests with their own canon and regional food alone.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se prireditev po kraju, terminu, namenu in značilnem programu.
topics.study_focus_en: Study events by place, date, purpose and characteristic programme.

topics.label_sl: Glavna mesta držav in zveznih enot
topics.description_sl: Povezovanje držav, zveznih držav, dežel in drugih upravnih enot z njihovimi prestolnicami.
topics.description_en: Associating sovereign states, federal states, provinces and other units with their capitals.
topics.inclusion: Direct capital-to-territory or territory-to-capital identification.
topics.exclusion: Other major cities, historical royal seats and city nicknames.
topics.study_focus_sl: Vadi ločena seznama državnih in poddržavnih prestolnic.
topics.study_focus_en: Practise separate lists of national and subnational capitals.

topics.description_sl: Lega držav in ozemelj po celinah, oceanijskih območjih in velikih svetovnih regijah.
topics.description_en: Location of countries and territories by continent, oceanic area and major world region.
topics.inclusion: Broad regional placement of a political territory.
topics.exclusion: Capitals, borders, island sovereignty and detailed country characteristics.
topics.study_focus_sl: Razvrsti države po celinah, podregijah in oceanskih območjih.
topics.study_focus_en: Classify countries by continent, subregion and oceanic area.

topics.label_sl: Državne meje, sosede, enklave in male države
topics.label_en: Country borders, neighbours, enclaves and microstates
topics.description_sl: Kopenske sosede, verige meja, države brez morja, enklave in geografski položaj malih držav.
topics.description_en: Land neighbours, border chains, landlocked states, enclaves and positions of microstates.
topics.inclusion: Ordinary international-border topology and landlocked status.
topics.exclusion: Active territorial disputes, coast rankings and historical empires.
topics.study_focus_sl: Vadi zemljevide sosedstva, enklav, izhodov na morje in malih držav.
topics.study_focus_en: Practise maps of neighbours, enclaves, sea access and microstates.

topics.description_sl: Politična pripadnost avtonomnih regij, spornih otočij in separatističnih ozemelj.
topics.description_en: Political status of autonomous regions, disputed islands and separatist territories.
topics.inclusion: Sovereignty or autonomy is contested or exceptional.
topics.exclusion: Uncontroversial neighbouring states and ordinary island location.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži sporna območja z zahtevki, upravljavci in stopnjo avtonomije.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect disputed areas with claimants, administrators and autonomy status.

topics.label_sl: Zgodovinska imena, vzdevki in preimenovanja držav
topics.label_en: Historical names, aliases and renaming of countries
topics.description_sl: Povezovanje nekdanjih državnih ali kolonialnih imen in uveljavljenih vzdevkov s sodobnimi državami.
topics.description_en: Mapping former state or colonial names and established aliases to modern countries.
topics.inclusion: Historical or alternative naming is the tested relationship.
topics.exclusion: Word etymology in isolation, ancient civilisations and flags.
topics.study_focus_sl: Sestavi tabelo nekdanjih imen, datumov preimenovanja in državnih vzdevkov.
topics.study_focus_en: Build a table of former names, renaming dates and country aliases.

topics.label_sl: Zastave, grbi in državni simboli sveta
topics.label_en: World flags, emblems and national symbols
topics.description_sl: Barve, geometrija, živali, zvezde in drugi elementi državnih zastav ter grbov.
topics.description_en: Colours, geometry, animals, stars and other elements of national flags and emblems.
topics.inclusion: Visual identification or composition of a non-Slovenian national symbol.
topics.exclusion: Anthems, Slovenian heraldry and commercial logos.
topics.study_focus_sl: Vadi zastave in grbe po barvah, razmerjih, simbolih in državah.
topics.study_focus_en: Practise flags and emblems by colours, proportions, symbols and countries.

topics.label_sl: Ljudstva, jeziki, pisave in imena prebivalcev
topics.description_sl: Staroselska ljudstva, uradni jeziki, razširjenost pisav in poimenovanja prebivalcev držav ali krajev.
topics.description_en: Indigenous peoples, official languages, distribution of scripts and names for inhabitants of places.
topics.inclusion: Geographic distribution or official status of peoples, languages and scripts.
topics.exclusion: Slovenian grammar and translation of individual foreign phrases.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži države in regije z ljudstvi, jeziki, pisavami in imeni prebivalcev.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect countries and regions with peoples, languages, scripts and demonyms.

topics.description_sl: Primerjave držav po prebivalstvu, površini, gostoti, obali, porabi in drugih merljivih skrajnostih.
topics.description_en: Country comparisons by population, area, density, coastline, consumption and other measurable extremes.
topics.inclusion: A country-level count, ranking or superlative is required.
topics.exclusion: Simple regional location, borders and economic theory.
topics.study_focus_sl: Preglej stabilne vrstne rede in približne velikostne razrede kazalnikov.
topics.study_focus_en: Review stable rank orders and approximate magnitudes of indicators.

topics.label_sl: Svetovna mesta, znamenitosti, ulice in četrti
topics.label_en: World cities, landmarks, streets and districts
topics.description_sl: Povezovanje mest z znamenitimi trgi, ulicami, četrtmi, pokopališči in kulturnimi točkami.
topics.description_en: Associating cities with famous squares, streets, districts, cemeteries and cultural sites.
topics.inclusion: The city-site or city-district relationship is the tested knowledge.
topics.exclusion: Capital status, architectural authorship and sports stadium identity.
topics.study_focus_sl: Pripravi zemljevide mest z značilnimi četrtmi, ulicami in znamenitostmi.
topics.study_focus_en: Prepare city maps with signature districts, streets and landmarks.

topics.label_sl: Svetovne reke, jezera, jezovi in slapovi
topics.label_en: World rivers, lakes, dams and waterfalls
topics.description_sl: Rečni tokovi, pritoki, izlivi, mesta ob rekah, meddržavna jezera, jezovi in slapovi.
topics.description_en: River courses, tributaries, mouths, river cities, transnational lakes, dams and waterfalls.
topics.inclusion: Named international inland-water geography.
topics.exclusion: Slovenian waters, oceanographic processes and aquatic animal habitats.
topics.study_focus_sl: Vadi zemljevide porečij, mest ob rekah, velikih jezer, jezov in slapov.
topics.study_focus_en: Practise maps of basins, river cities, major lakes, dams and waterfalls.

topics.label_sl: Morja, oceani, ožine, obale in rti
topics.label_en: Seas, oceans, straits, coasts and capes
topics.description_sl: Lega morij, dostop držav do obale, ožine, rti, pristanišča in osnovno plimovanje.
topics.description_en: Locations of seas, national sea access, straits, capes, harbours and basic tides.
topics.inclusion: Marine geography and coastal landforms.
topics.exclusion: Islands as territories, ships and atmospheric weather.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži morja z državami, ožinami, rti, pristanišči in sosednjimi celinami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect seas with countries, straits, capes, ports and adjacent continents.

topics.description_sl: Lega otokov, članstvo v otočjih ter njihova običajna politična pripadnost.
topics.description_en: Locations of islands, archipelago membership and their ordinary political affiliation.
topics.inclusion: An island's location, group or uncontested sovereign association.
topics.exclusion: Disputed territories, inland lakes and coastal capes.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži otoke z otočji, morji, državami in glavnimi mesti.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect islands with archipelagos, seas, countries and capitals.

topics.label_sl: Gorovja, vrhovi in velike reliefne pokrajine
topics.label_en: Mountain ranges, peaks and major landforms
topics.description_sl: Lega, višina in značilnosti svetovnih gorovij, vrhov, puščav, fjordov in drugih reliefnih enot.
topics.description_en: Location, elevation and characteristics of world ranges, peaks, deserts, fjords and other landforms.
topics.inclusion: Named physical-geography features and continental relief boundaries.
topics.exclusion: Climbing achievements, Slovenian protected areas and geological formation mechanisms.
topics.study_focus_sl: Vadi zemljevid gorovij, najvišjih vrhov, puščav in značilnih reliefnih regij.
topics.study_focus_en: Practise a map of ranges, highest peaks, deserts and signature landform regions.

topics.label_sl: Zemlja, kartografija, koordinate in globalne meritve
topics.label_en: Earth, mapping, coordinates and global measurements
topics.description_sl: Ekvator, poldnevniki, zemeljski obseg, strani neba in osnovna merila zemljevidov.
topics.description_en: The equator, meridians, Earth's circumference, cardinal directions and basic map measurements.
topics.inclusion: Global reference systems and elementary cartographic measurement.
topics.exclusion: Country rankings, astronomy and mathematical geometry without a map context.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi koordinatno mrežo, glavne vzporednike, poldnevnike in merila.
topics.study_focus_en: Review the coordinate grid, major parallels, meridians and scales.

topics.label_sl: Stari Egipt in civilizacije Bližnjega vzhoda
topics.label_en: Ancient Egypt and Near Eastern civilisations
topics.description_sl: Faraoni, piramide, mezopotamska mesta, pisave, zakoniki in zgodnje države.
topics.description_en: Pharaohs, pyramids, Mesopotamian cities, scripts, law codes and early states.
topics.inclusion: Historical societies of Egypt, Mesopotamia and the ancient Near East.
topics.exclusion: Their gods as mythology and present-day country geography.
topics.study_focus_sl: Sestavi časovnico vladarjev, mest, pisav, zakonikov in državnih prehodov.
topics.study_focus_en: Build a timeline of rulers, cities, scripts, law codes and state transitions.

topics.description_sl: Polisi, ljudstva, ustanovitev Rima, cesarji, vojne, pravo in politična geografija antike.
topics.description_en: Poleis, peoples, Rome's foundation, emperors, wars, law and political geography of antiquity.
topics.inclusion: Historical people, institutions and events of Greece and Rome.
topics.exclusion: Mythological deities, heroic myths and later archaeological tourism.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi politične ureditve, vladarje, vojne, mesta in časovno zaporedje.
topics.study_focus_en: Review political systems, rulers, wars, cities and chronology.

topics.label_sl: Srednjeveška Evropa, viteški redovi in križarske vojne
topics.label_en: Medieval Europe, military orders and Crusades
topics.description_sl: Vladarji, fevdalne ustanove, bitke, templjarji, drugi redovi, križarske vojne in cerkveni razkol.
topics.description_en: Rulers, feudal institutions, battles, Templars, other orders, Crusades and church schism.
topics.inclusion: European medieval political, military or institutional history.
topics.exclusion: Slovenian medieval history, later royal genealogy and modern religious orders.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se obdobij, redov, pohodov, vladarjev, bitk in fevdalnih ustanov.
topics.study_focus_en: Study periods, orders, campaigns, rulers, battles and feudal institutions.

topics.description_sl: Rodovniki, zakoni, vzdevki, kronanja, nasledstvo, dvori in pogrebne tradicije monarhov.
topics.description_en: Genealogy, marriages, epithets, coronations, succession, courts and burial traditions of monarchs.
topics.inclusion: Royal identity and dynastic relationships from the medieval period onward.
topics.exclusion: Current elected leaders and wars where the dynasty is incidental.
topics.study_focus_sl: Nariši rodovnike ter preglej vladarske dobe, vzdevke in nasledstvene povezave.
topics.study_focus_en: Draw family trees and review reigns, epithets and succession links.

topics.description_sl: Odprave, poti do Indije, prva obplutja, odkritja in voditelji raziskovalnih potovanj.
topics.description_en: Expeditions, routes to India, first circumnavigations, discoveries and voyage leaders.
topics.inclusion: Historical exploration routes and achievements.
topics.exclusion: Ship construction, island geography and modern scientific space missions.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži raziskovalce s potmi, ladjami, pokrovitelji, datumi in dosežki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect explorers with routes, ships, patrons, dates and achievements.

topics.description_sl: Napoleonov vzpon, bitke, politične tvorbe, porazi, izgnanstvo in smrt.
topics.description_en: Napoleon's rise, battles, political creations, defeats, exile and death.
topics.inclusion: Events and places directly forming the Napoleonic historical sequence.
topics.exclusion: Later French politics and ordinary geography of the locations.
topics.study_focus_sl: Sestavi časovnico bitk, zavezništev, porazov, izgnanstev in političnih sprememb.
topics.study_focus_en: Build a timeline of battles, alliances, defeats, exiles and political changes.

topics.label_sl: Prva svetovna vojna in mirovne pogodbe
topics.label_en: First World War and peace settlements
topics.description_sl: Frontne črte, bojišča, vojaški dogodki in povojne pogodbe prve svetovne vojne.
topics.description_en: Fronts, battlefields, military events and post-war treaties of the First World War.
topics.inclusion: World War I and its immediate diplomatic settlement.
topics.exclusion: World War II operations and later Cold War borders.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi fronte, ključne bitke, udeležence in povojne pogodbe.
topics.study_focus_en: Review fronts, key battles, participants and post-war treaties.

topics.label_sl: Operacije in bitke druge svetovne vojne
topics.label_en: Second World War operations and battles
topics.description_sl: Poimenovane operacije, velike bitke, vojaška letala, orožje in načini bojevanja med drugo svetovno vojno.
topics.description_en: Named operations, major battles, military aircraft, weapons and forms of combat in the Second World War.
topics.inclusion: Operational and battlefield history of World War II.
topics.exclusion: Occupation persecution, Holocaust biography and post-war atomic policy.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži operacije z bojišči, letnicami, poveljniki, cilji in izidi.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect operations with theatres, dates, commanders, aims and outcomes.

topics.label_sl: Okupacija, odpor in preganjanje med drugo svetovno vojno
topics.label_en: Occupation, resistance and persecution in the Second World War
topics.description_sl: Okupacijski režimi, odporniška oporišča, poboji, vojni zločinci in holokavst.
topics.description_en: Occupation regimes, resistance bases, massacres, war criminals and the Holocaust.
topics.inclusion: Civilian occupation, resistance, persecution and perpetrator history.
topics.exclusion: Battlefield operations and general modern crime.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se okupacijskih območij, odporniških gibanj, žrtev, storilcev in krajev spomina.
topics.study_focus_en: Study occupation zones, resistance movements, victims, perpetrators and memorial sites.

topics.label_sl: Hladna vojna, demokratične revolucije in vohunjenje
topics.label_en: Cold War, democratic revolutions and espionage
topics.description_sl: Berlinski zid, vzhodnoevropski prehodi, protikomunistične revolucije in obveščevalne operacije.
topics.description_en: The Berlin Wall, Eastern European transitions, anti-communist revolutions and intelligence operations.
topics.inclusion: Cold War blocs, transitions and espionage tied to their geopolitical conflict.
topics.exclusion: Ordinary country renaming and current security institutions.
topics.study_focus_sl: Sestavi časovnico kriz, zidov, revolucij, služb in prehodov oblasti.
topics.study_focus_en: Build a timeline of crises, walls, revolutions, agencies and transfers of power.

topics.label_sl: Diktatorji, državni udari in avtoritarni režimi
topics.description_sl: Avtoritarni voditelji, načini prevzema oblasti, državne ideologije in represivni režimi.
topics.description_en: Authoritarian leaders, routes to power, state ideologies and repressive regimes.
topics.inclusion: A dictatorship, coup or authoritarian ruler is the preparation unit.
topics.exclusion: Democratic officeholders, monarchs and a war without regime analysis.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži voditelje z državami, udari, obdobji, ideologijami in padci režimov.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect leaders with countries, coups, periods, ideologies and regime collapse.

topics.label_sl: Gibanja za državljanske pravice in osvoboditev
topics.description_sl: Apartheid, nenasilni odpor, emancipacijska gibanja, revolucionarne kampanje in njihovi voditelji.
topics.description_en: Apartheid, nonviolent resistance, emancipation movements, revolutionary campaigns and their leaders.
topics.inclusion: Collective struggle for political or civil emancipation.
topics.exclusion: Routine government office, dictatorship biography without a movement and military conquest.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži gibanja z voditelji, cilji, metodami, zakoni in doseženimi spremembami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect movements with leaders, aims, methods, laws and achieved changes.

topics.label_sl: Sodobni politični voditelji in državne funkcije
topics.label_en: Modern political leaders and state offices
topics.description_sl: Identiteta, država, funkcija, mandat in biografske povezave predsednikov ter premierjev.
topics.description_en: Identity, country, office, term and biographical connections of presidents and prime ministers.
topics.inclusion: Modern non-Slovenian democratic or general political officeholders.
topics.exclusion: Dictators, monarchs, Slovenian constitutional administration and papal religious office.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži voditelje z državami, funkcijami, mandati, nasledniki in ključnimi politikami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect leaders with countries, offices, terms, successors and key policies.

topics.label_sl: Evropska unija, mednarodne organizacije in javni programi
topics.label_en: European Union, international organisations and public programmes
topics.description_sl: Namen, članstvo, ustanove, simboli in programi EU ter drugih nadnacionalnih organizacij.
topics.description_en: Purpose, membership, institutions, symbols and programmes of the EU and other supranational organisations.
topics.inclusion: Institutional identity or function is more important than acronym expansion.
topics.exclusion: Private clubs, security agencies and abbreviation questions without institutional content.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži organizacije z namenom, članicami, organi, sedeži, simboli in programi.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect organisations with purposes, members, bodies, seats, symbols and programmes.

topics.label_sl: Vojne, politični spopadi in mirovni procesi
topics.label_en: Wars, political conflicts and peace processes
topics.description_sl: Povodi, trajanje, ključni dogodki in izidi konfliktov zunaj posebej obravnavanih svetovnih vojn.
topics.description_en: Causes, duration, key events and outcomes of conflicts outside the separately covered world wars.
topics.inclusion: A named armed conflict or its settlement is central.
topics.exclusion: Isolated weapons, coups without warfare and ordinary border geography.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se konfliktov po straneh, povodih, časovnici, prelomnicah in sporazumih.
topics.study_focus_en: Study conflicts by sides, causes, chronology, turning points and agreements.

topics.description_sl: Oporišča, rodovi vojske, oblegovalno orožje, zažigalne snovi, vojaške ladje in obrambne ustanove.
topics.description_en: Bases, service branches, siege weapons, incendiaries, warships and defence institutions.
topics.inclusion: A military object, organisation or defensive technique rather than a whole war.
topics.exclusion: Civilian transport technology and battle chronology.
topics.study_focus_sl: Razvrsti orožje, enote, plovila in obrambne sisteme po obdobju ter namenu.
topics.study_focus_en: Classify weapons, units, vessels and defence systems by period and purpose.

topics.label_sl: Zgodovinski kriminal, razbojniki, terorizem in katastrofe
topics.label_en: Historical crime, outlaws, terrorism and disasters
topics.description_sl: Znani razbojniki, kriminalni pari, organizirani kriminal, atentati, teroristični napadi in zgodovinske katastrofe.
topics.description_en: Famous outlaws, criminal couples, organised crime, assassinations, terrorist attacks and historical disasters.
topics.inclusion: A named criminal, attack or historically notable human-made disaster.
topics.exclusion: Legal terminology, ordinary policing and wartime persecution.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži osebe in dogodke s kraji, obdobji, dejanji, žrtvami ter posledicami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect people and events with places, periods, acts, victims and consequences.

topics.description_sl: Avtorstvo izumov, prvi tehnični dosežki, proizvodni postopki in začetki množične proizvodnje.
topics.description_en: Inventorship, first technical achievements, production processes and beginnings of mass production.
topics.inclusion: Historical origin or pioneer of a technology.
topics.exclusion: Present-day device use and fundamental scientific laws.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži izume z izumitelji, letnicami, predhodniki in industrijskimi postopki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect inventions with inventors, dates, precursors and industrial processes.

topics.description_sl: Osebe, odnosi, kraji, predmeti in pripovedni dogodki Stare ter Nove zaveze.
topics.description_en: People, relationships, places, objects and narrative events of the Old and New Testaments.
topics.inclusion: The answer comes from a biblical narrative.
topics.exclusion: Later church offices, saints' traditions and general Christian doctrine.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se pripovedi po osebah, rodovih, krajih, simbolih in zaporedju dogodkov.
topics.study_focus_en: Study narratives by people, lineages, places, symbols and event sequence.

topics.label_sl: Krščansko Sveto pismo, nauk in besedilno izročilo
topics.label_en: Christian Bible, doctrine and textual tradition
topics.description_sl: Trojica, dogme, kanon, prevodi in različice krščanskih svetih besedil.
topics.description_en: The Trinity, dogmas, canon, translations and versions of Christian sacred texts.
topics.inclusion: Doctrinal or textual knowledge rather than a narrative episode.
topics.exclusion: Holiday customs, papal biography and architecture.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi osnovne nauke, zgradbo Svetega pisma in pomembne prevode.
topics.study_focus_en: Review core doctrines, biblical structure and major translations.

topics.description_sl: Papeška imena, konklave, vatikanske ustanove, cerkvene službe in meniški ali duhovniški redovi.
topics.description_en: Papal names, conclaves, Vatican institutions, church offices and monastic or clerical orders.
topics.inclusion: Formal church office, Vatican practice or religious-order membership.
topics.exclusion: Biblical narratives, Crusader military orders and saints' feast days.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži papeže, službe, redove, simbole, postopke volitev in ustanove.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect popes, offices, orders, symbols, election procedures and institutions.

topics.label_sl: Krščanski koledar, svetniki in praznični običaji
topics.label_en: Christian calendar, saints and festive customs
topics.description_sl: Advent, pepelnica, godovi, Miklavž, jaslice in drugi sezonski krščanski običaji.
topics.description_en: Advent, Ash Wednesday, saints' days, Saint Nicholas, Nativity scenes and other seasonal Christian customs.
topics.inclusion: Christian feast timing, saint association or seasonal religious practice.
topics.exclusion: Secular public festivals and doctrinal theology.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se praznikov po datumu, liturgičnem obdobju, svetniku, simbolih in običajih.
topics.study_focus_en: Study feasts by date, liturgical season, saint, symbols and customs.

topics.description_sl: Grška božanstva, sorodstva, področja moči, simboli, živali in prepoznavni atributi.
topics.description_en: Greek deities, kinship, domains, symbols, animals and identifying attributes.
topics.inclusion: A deity's identity, portfolio or divine relationship is central.
topics.exclusion: Heroic quests, monsters and Roman equivalence as the primary test.
topics.study_focus_sl: Nariši rodovnik bogov ter poveži vsakega s področjem, simbolom in atributom.
topics.study_focus_en: Draw the divine family tree and link each god to domains, symbols and attributes.

topics.label_sl: Grški junaki, pošasti in mitični predmeti
topics.label_en: Greek heroes, monsters and mythic objects
topics.description_sl: Junaške odprave, pošasti, prekletstva, orožje in drugi predmeti grškega mita.
topics.description_en: Heroic quests, monsters, curses, weapons and other objects of Greek myth.
topics.inclusion: A heroic episode, non-divine creature or mythic object is central.
topics.exclusion: A god's general domain and authored modern fantasy.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži junake z odpravami, nasprotniki, pomočniki, predmeti in izidi.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect heroes with quests, opponents, helpers, objects and outcomes.

topics.label_sl: Rimska, nordijska in druge stare mitologije
topics.label_en: Roman, Norse and other ancient mythologies
topics.description_sl: Rimska imena bogov, nordijska božanstva in hierarhije ter egipčanski ali drugi stari panteoni.
topics.description_en: Roman divine names, Norse gods and hierarchies, and Egyptian or other ancient pantheons.
topics.inclusion: Ancient mythology outside the specifically separated Greek clusters.
topics.exclusion: Historical emperors, ancient states and living religious practice.
topics.study_focus_sl: Primerjaj panteone, ustreznice, rodovnike, simbole in kozmološke vloge.
topics.study_focus_en: Compare pantheons, equivalents, family trees, symbols and cosmological roles.

topics.description_sl: Nastanek, razširjenost, ustanovitelji, koledarji, nauki in simboli nekrščanskih ver ter novih gibanj.
topics.description_en: Origins, distribution, founders, calendars, teachings and symbols of non-Christian religions and newer movements.
topics.inclusion: Comparative knowledge of living religions and belief systems.
topics.exclusion: Christian doctrine, ancient mythology and folk divination.
topics.study_focus_sl: Primerjaj vere po nastanku, svetih besedilih, naukih, simbolih, praznikih in razširjenosti.
topics.study_focus_en: Compare religions by origin, texts, teachings, symbols, festivals and distribution.

topics.description_sl: Kralj Matjaž, lokalne legende, vampirji, astrologija, hiromantija in druga ljudska verovanja.
topics.description_en: King Matjaž, local legends, vampires, astrology, palmistry and other folk beliefs.
topics.inclusion: Non-canonical legend, supernatural folklore or divinatory practice.
topics.exclusion: Greek myth, formal religion and authored fantasy worlds.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži legende z območji in liki ter vedeževalske prakse z njihovimi znamenji.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect legends with regions and figures, and divination practices with their signs.

topics.description_sl: Poklicne poti, prestopi, položaji, osebni dosežki in trenerske kariere nogometnih osebnosti.
topics.description_en: Careers, transfers, positions, personal achievements and coaching paths of football figures.
topics.inclusion: The individual player or coach is the primary preparation unit.
topics.exclusion: National-team records, club identity, match rules and stadium geography.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži igralce in trenerje s karierami, položaji, klubi ter osebnimi dosežki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect players and coaches with careers, positions, clubs and personal achievements.

topics.label_sl: Nogometni klubi, lovorike in klubska identiteta
topics.description_sl: Imena, grbi, barve, vzdevki, rivalstva in osvojene lovorike nogometnih klubov.
topics.description_en: Names, badges, colours, nicknames, rivalries and titles of football clubs.
topics.inclusion: Stable club identity or team-level achievement.
topics.exclusion: A player's biography, national teams and stadium location alone.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži klube z mesti, barvami, grbi, vzdevki, tekmeci in lovorikami.
topics.study_focus_en: Study clubs by city, colours, badge, nickname, rivals and honours.

topics.label_en: Football national teams and international records
topics.description_sl: Pripadnost reprezentancam, strelci, selektorji, reprezentančne tradicije in dosežki na reprezentančnih tekmovanjih.
topics.description_en: National-team affiliation, scorers, managers, traditions and international achievements.
topics.inclusion: Representative-team identity or national-team record.
topics.exclusion: Club careers and tournament format considered independently.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži reprezentance z igralci, selektorji, vzdevki, nastopi in rekordi.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect national teams with players, managers, nicknames, appearances and records.

topics.label_sl: Nogometna tekmovanja, znamenite tekme in rekordi
topics.label_en: Football competitions, famous matches and records
topics.description_sl: Svetovna in celinska prvenstva, finali, preobrati, rekordni dogodki in zgodovinske okoliščine znamenitih zadetkov.
topics.description_en: World and continental tournaments, finals, comebacks, record events and contexts of famous goals.
topics.inclusion: A competition, edition, match or match record is central.
topics.exclusion: General player biography, club identity and rules.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uči se formatov, gostiteljev, prvakov, finalov, rekordov in prelomnih tekem.
topics.study_focus_en: Study formats, hosts, champions, finals, records and landmark matches.

topics.label_sl: Nogometna pravila, izrazje in sodniška tehnologija
topics.label_en: Football rules, terminology and match technology
topics.description_sl: Igrišče, oprema, postavitve, sodniške odločitve, VAR in formalna pravila nogometne tekme.
topics.description_en: Pitch, equipment, formations, officiating, VAR and formal laws of a football match.
topics.inclusion: How football is played, officiated or technically administered.
topics.exclusion: Player careers, supporter culture and tournament results.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi mere igrišča, igralne položaje, prekinitve, prekrške, opremo in sodniško tehnologijo.
topics.study_focus_en: Review pitch dimensions, positions, restarts, fouls, equipment and officiating technology.

topics.label_en: Football stadiums, venues and supporter culture
topics.description_sl: Domači stadioni, njihove lokacije in imena ter navijaške skupine, pesmi in običaji.
topics.description_en: Home stadiums, their locations and names, plus supporter groups, songs, colours and customs.
topics.inclusion: The venue or supporter identity is the tested knowledge.
topics.exclusion: Club titles, general urban landmarks and formal match rules.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži klube s stadioni in mesti, navijaškimi skupinami, pesmimi ter običaji.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect clubs with stadiums, cities, supporter groups, colours and customs.

topics.label_en: Basketball players, records and jersey numbers
topics.description_sl: Igralci, statistični rekordi, družinske povezave, nastopi in številke dresov.
topics.description_en: Players, statistical records, family links, appearances and jersey numbers.
topics.inclusion: Individual basketball biography or performance record.
topics.exclusion: Team or league identity, coaching and tactical terminology.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži igralce z ekipami, številkami, rekordi, sorodstvi in reprezentančnimi dosežki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect players with teams, numbers, records, relatives and international achievements.

topics.description_sl: Klubi, reprezentance, trenerji, poklicne lige in zgodovina slovenske, jugoslovanske ali NBA košarke.
topics.description_en: Clubs, national teams, coaches, professional leagues and Slovenian, Yugoslav or NBA basketball history.
topics.inclusion: Team-level, league-level or coaching knowledge.
topics.exclusion: An individual's statistical record and rules of play.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži ekipe z ligami, trenerji, obdobji, začetnimi peterkami in lovorikami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect teams with leagues, coaches, eras, starting lineups and honours.

topics.description_sl: Točkovanje, igralni položaji, sestava igre, prekrški in taktične akcije, kot je pick-and-roll.
topics.description_en: Scoring, positions, game structure, violations and tactical actions such as the pick-and-roll.
topics.inclusion: How basketball is played or tactically organised.
topics.exclusion: Player statistics, jersey numbers and league history.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi točkovanje, časovna pravila, položaje, prekrške in osnovne akcije.
topics.study_focus_en: Review scoring, timing rules, positions, violations and basic plays.

topics.label_sl: Tenis: igralci, turnirji, pravila in izrazje
topics.label_en: Tennis: players, tournaments, rules and terminology
topics.description_sl: Točkovanje, igrišča, udarci, izrazi, pomembni igralci in turnirski dosežki.
topics.description_en: Scoring, courts, strokes, terminology, major players and tournament achievements.
topics.inclusion: Tennis-specific playing knowledge or competitive canon.
topics.exclusion: Other racket sports and general Olympic medal counts.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi točkovanje, vrste podlag, udarce, turnirje za grand slam in prvake.

topics.label_en: Astronomy, the Solar System and celestial phenomena

topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži odprave s plovili, cilji, posadkami, izstrelišči in dosežki.

topics.description_sl: Oblaki, plasti ozračja, vrste padavin, lokalni vetrovi, cikloni in osnovni vremenski procesi.

topics.inclusion: Classical or relativistic physical principles and measurement.

topics.study_focus_en: Review quantities, units, core laws, forces, waves and canonical thought experiments.

topics.inclusion: Atomic nucleus, radiation type or nuclear technology.

topics.inclusion: Element identity or bulk material property.
topics.exclusion: Compounds and pH, geological classification and nutritional substances.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi simbole, skupine periodnega sistema, izvor imen in značilne lastnosti snovi.

topics.description_sl: Sestava spojin, kemijske reakcije, kisline, baze in merjenje kislosti.
topics.description_en: Composition of compounds, chemical reactions, acids, bases and acidity measurement.
topics.inclusion: Ordinary chemical composition or transformation beyond element recognition.
topics.exclusion: Nuclear reactions, biological proteins and cooking processes.

editorial_notes: Classify semantically after reading the complete question and all four options; never infer a topic from isolated keywords.

Choose the topic representing the knowledge resource a contestant would study. Location-only questions go to geography, while architectural, sporting, culinary or biological knowledge remains in its specialist topic.
For works and adaptations, follow the tested medium: book text and literary characters go to literature; actors, scenes, production and screen-specific plots go to film or television.
For people, distinguish personal biography from the institution, team, work, event or record actually being tested.

Football is intentionally separated into players/coaches, clubs, national teams, competitions and records, rules and technology, and venues/supporter culture. Apply the same tested-object principle throughout sport.
Proverbs are complete conventional propositions; idioms are shorter fixed figurative expressions. Quotations traceable to a particular song or literary work remain with that work.

Named Slovenian cultural works remain in their cultural domains. The Slovenia navigation domain is reserved for government, history, physical geography, local identity, heritage, transport, industry and public events.

Do not create an operational other, general, miscellaneous or general-knowledge topic. If a future cluster repeatedly fails these boundaries, review a semantic sample and add or split a coherent preparation unit.
